notes:
# DCU 1.1.6

- Accept the utility App's variable-length grid-ID writes at HR0001: 1–8
  registers replace the entire logical field and zero-pad the unused suffix.
  Empty strings clear it; malformed UTF-8, oversized values and partial floats
  remain rejected. The existing fixed 16-byte App writes still work.
- Accept minute/second 00–59 for reporting time, including 00:00:00, matching
  the utility App's HH:mm encoding with seconds=00. Hour remains 0–12 and the
  three reserved bytes remain zero. No persistence/schema reset is performed.
- Firmware C regression checks cover the exact short grid write observed from
  the utility App, stale-suffix clearing, empty clearing and zero time values.

## Retained from 1.1.5

- Match the utility DCU GATT interface: 5058 supports writes with and without
  response; 5059 supports both notification and reading the last encrypted reply.
- Support authenticated notification/reporting-enable setting HR 0x0600 and
  momentary wake-up control HR 0x0900. No plaintext fallback is added.
- Migrate the existing 31-byte v1 settings record to the 33-byte v2 record in
  memory while preserving all four installation fields across OTA/reboots.
- Add RTT request metadata diagnostics without keys or decrypted field values.
- Cross-tested on the tablet: the utility App reads all four fields from this
  firmware; our App 1.1.5+7 reads the real type-8 DCU, including its 76-byte
  basic-block grid reply. Real-device installation fields were not written.
- This remains a four-field settings implementation, not a complete MQTT/FCI
  relay, input-register, event-log or server-reporting implementation.

## Retained from 1.1.4

- Implement the actual DCU GATT service 0x5057, write characteristic 0x5058
  and notification characteristic 0x5059 for the mobile settings page.
- Authenticate the mobile client (0x03) using the existing device-name-derived
  AES-128-GCM profile, CRC16 and per-connection invocation-counter checks.
- Read/write grid ID (0x0001, 16 UTF-8 bytes), latitude (0x0023, float32),
  longitude (0x0025, float32), reporting time (0x060B, 6 bytes).
- Save validated whole-field changes through Zephyr settings/NVS before sending
  a write acknowledgement. Failed storage leaves the current values unchanged.
  Repeated unchanged writes avoid unnecessary flash writes.
- Keep UART relay count, existing BLE advertising identity and SMP/MCUboot OTA.
- Reporting-time interpretation follows the draft: hour 0–12, minute/second
  1–59, reserved bytes zero. Defaults are empty grid, 0 coordinates, 00:01:01.
  These are unset/default values, not measured GPS coordinates. No scheduler,
  server reporting, FCI passthrough or wake-up command is introduced here.
- Provision only derived per-device Mobile EK/AK locally; the generated key
  header is excluded from Git and no master keys are included in source.

## Retained from 1.1.3

- Add the PDF section 2.5 DCU advertising service-list field:
  AD type 0x03, bytes 57 50 (16-bit service UUID 0x5057).
- Primary advertising now contains flags, DCU service identity and the formal
  name within 23 bytes; SMP OTA remains in the scan response.
- Version 1.1.3 supplied discovery identification only; the settings service is
  added in 1.1.4 above.

## Retained from 1.1.2

- Put the complete formal name in primary advertising data (19 bytes total),
  with the SMP UUID in the scan response (18 bytes). This lets name-based scans
  show the device without waiting for a scan-response merge.

## Retained from 1.1.1

- Formal BLE name is TPC_T626B00001: manufacturer T, overhead branch DCU
  (type 6), November 2026, serial 00001.
- Put the complete 14-byte name in the scan response, keeping the SMP service
  UUID in advertising data within the legacy 31-byte limit.
- Build/release checks validate the formal DCU name and record it in metadata.
- UART alternating count, BLE identity/settings and MCUboot OTA remain compatible.

## Retained from 1.1.0

- BLE Device Information Service reports firmware version from VERSION.
- RTT reports version, MCUboot confirmation state and pending swap type.
- RTT reports MCUmgr upload start/stop, pending image and confirmation events.
- Confirming inactive slots is disabled: test the new running image first.
- MCUmgr checks image size against the MCUboot sysbuild configuration.
- Release packaging checks image version, DIS version and signature, then records
  binary size and file SHA-256. Published versions cannot be overwritten.
- UART alternating count and STM32 protocol remain compatible.

Current signing key is the SDK development key, unchanged for compatibility
with the installed bootloader. This release does not provision a production key.
